description: Compass' ESSENTIAL RULES, tested — a regression guard
not_checked: rules 4, 5, 6 (album-ID format, theme injection, rune usage) cannot be tested from a substring without manufacturing findings
note: A guard's value is the day it fires, not the day it passes.

guards.note: Other z-values are NOT a violation — the rule names three layers, it does not forbid others. Listed so a stacking surprise is legible.

guards.law: SQLite batch limit 999 params · INSERT_BATCH = 50 rows
guards.note: A batch of N rows uses N x (columns) params. This reader checks the CONSTANT against the ceiling; it cannot compute columns-per-row from a substring and does not pretend to. A hand multiplies.

guards.law: Android: capabilities/default.json needs explicit sql:allow-* permissions
Android: scanning public Music/Download needs READ_MEDIA_AUDIO
guards.note: gen/ is gitignored and regenerated (rule 10), so an absent manifest here is NOT a finding — it means the Android project has not been generated in this working tree. Absence of a file this reader cannot expect is not a defect.

guards.law: Android: no emoji or non-ASCII in SQL DEFAULT values — silent JNI failure
Android: gen/ gitignored and regenerated; extras auto-sync via scripts/sync-android-extras.mjs each build
